text_blocks.snippet: The best way to manage COVID-19 depends on individual risk factors and the severity of symptoms. For those at high risk, oral antiviral medications like Paxlovid (nirmatrelvir with ritonavir) or Lagevrio (molnupiravir), or the intravenous antiviral remdesivir (Veklury) may be recommended. For others, over-the-counter medications and supportive care may be sufficient. It is crucial to consult with a healthcare professional to determine the most appropriate course of action.

list.snippet: Paxlovid (nirmatrelvir with ritonavir): An oral antiviral taken at home for adults and children 12 years and older who are at high risk.
Remdesivir (Veklury): An intravenous antiviral administered in a healthcare facility for 3 days for adults and children.
Molnupiravir (Lagevrio): An oral antiviral taken at home for adults at high risk.
Over-the-counter pain relievers and fever reducers (e.g., acetaminophen, ibuprofen).

list.snippet: Depending on individual needs and circumstances, other treatments like monoclonal antibody infusions may be considered.
Risk Factors: Individuals with certain underlying health conditions, older adults, and those who are immunocompromised are at higher risk for severe COVID-19.
Symptom Severity: Treatment options are often tailored to the severity of symptoms.
Consult a Doctor: It is essential to consult with a healthcare professional to determine the most appropriate treatment plan.
